## Data Surface

Record what data this repo touches so agents can recognize data-impacting changes before editing. Use `not configured` or `none` honestly; do not invent rows.

| Surface | Path or system | Classification | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| User-identifying fields | `not confirmed` | `not confirmed` | Complete from checked-in schema/model/logging evidence. |
| Customer records | `not confirmed` | `not confirmed` | Complete from checked-in data access paths. |
| Audit / compliance logs | `not confirmed` | `not confirmed` | Include retention and redaction expectations when known. |
| Analytics / telemetry events | `not confirmed` | `not confirmed` | Include external destinations when known. |
| Exports / external integrations | `not confirmed` | `not confirmed` | Include trust boundary and data-sharing notes when known. |
| Destructive data operations | `not confirmed` | `not confirmed` | Name scripts, migrations, or admin flows when known. |

Data-touching changes must reference this table in the run plan and re-run the relevant gate or, if no gate exists, mark it `not configured` with the missing scanner named.
